tool.name: nasvar pipeline
tool.description: tumor-only long-read variant calling (SNV / CNV / fusions / ITD / karyotype)

param.name: bam
param.label: Aligned BAM (tumor)
param.help: Sorted and indexed BAM/CRAM. Galaxy provides the .bai/.crai index automatically alongside the dataset.

param.name: fasta_source
param.label: Reference genome (FASTA, indexed)
param.help: Admin-installed reference genome from the all_fasta data table.

validator.message: No indexed reference genome is registered in this Galaxy. Ask the admin to install one via the data manager.

param.name: gff
param.label: Gene annotations (GFF3)
param.help: Must match the chosen reference genome coordinates.

param.name: repeats
param.label: Repetitive regions (BED)
param.help: Used for coverage masking and BAF site filtering.

param.name: sites
param.label: MAF sites (TSV)
param.help: Tab-separated SNP positions for BAF: CHR POS REF ALT.

param.name: reference
param.label: Reference genome configuration (JSON)
param.help: Centromere and PAR coordinates for the chosen reference genome (e.g. T2T-CHM13v2.0).

param.name: enriched
param.label: Enriched regions (BED)
param.help: Regions targeted by adaptive sampling on the sequencer.

param.name: targets
param.label: Gene targets (BED)
param.help: Enriched genes of interest for fusion calling (no padding).

param.name: config
param.label: Pipeline configuration (JSON)
param.help: Panel-specific: gene list, thresholds, SNV transcripts, one-sided genes.

param.name: blast_ratio
param.label: Tumor fraction (blast ratio)
param.help: Optional. Estimated tumor fraction in [0.0, 1.0] for copy number adjustment. Leave empty for no adjustment.

param.name: min_depth
param.label: Minimum read depth at MAF site
param.help: Sites below this depth are treated as spacers in the BAF plot. nasvar default: 20.

param.name: plot_y_percentile
param.label: Karyotype plot y-axis percentile
param.help: Per-segment percentile for the karyotype plot y-axis limit. nasvar default: 0.95.

data.name: breakpoints_fa
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: fusion breakpoint consensus (empty if no fusions)

tool.help:
**nasvar pipeline** — full tumor-only long-read variant calling pipeline.
Detects SNVs, CNVs, gene fusions, internal tandem duplications, and infers karyotypes from aligned BAM/CRAM files produced by Oxford Nanopore PromethION sequencing, typically with adaptive sampling on a targeted gene panel.
This wrapper was developed for clinical-research use on B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL) in collaboration with the Institut de la Leucémie (Paris).
----
**Inputs grouped by coherence**
- **Per-sample**: aligned tumor BAM. - **Reference-genome bundle**: FASTA (admin-installed), GFF3, repeats BED, MAF sites TSV, reference JSON. All five must describe the *same* reference genome — mismatch will silently produce wrong calls. - **Panel bundle**: enriched BED, targets BED, pipeline JSON. All three must describe the *same* analysis panel.
**Outputs**
- ``result.json`` — unified JSON with all variant calls, QC, and metadata - ``coverage.tsv``, ``coverage.gc_adjusted.tsv`` — binned read depth (raw + GC-corrected) - ``maf`` — minor allele frequencies at SNP sites - ``breakpoints.fa`` — fusion breakpoint consensus sequences (empty if no fusions detected) - ``karyotype.gc_corrected.svg`` — karyotype coverage plot - ``karyotype_baf.gc_corrected.svg`` — karyotype + BAF combined plot - ``gc_vs_coverage.svg`` — GC bias diagnostic plot - ``log`` — nasvar execution log
